blocks.html: 30ft Cuddy Cabin – Private Fishing Charter in San José del Cabo

The 30ft Cuddy Cabin is a private fishing charter designed for families and groups of up to six guests departing from Puerto Los Cabos Marina in San José del Cabo.

What makes this 30-foot fishing boat particularly appealing is its combination of open fishing space and sheltered onboard comfort. Unlike smaller open boats, its cuddy cabin provides a protected area where guests can take a break from the sun and wind. Comfortable seating and an onboard toilet make it a practical option for families, friends, and anglers who appreciate additional amenities during their fishing trip.

The boat offers opportunities to explore the productive fishing waters of the Sea of Cortez, where seasonal species include yellowfin tuna, dorado (mahi-mahi), wahoo, and marlin. Fishing locations and techniques depend on ocean conditions, fish activity, and the group's preferences.

Each private charter includes fishing rods, reels, basic tackle, bottled water, and soft drinks. Fishing licenses, bait, meals, transportation, and fish-cleaning arrangements should be confirmed before booking.

Private fishing charter for 1–6 guests. Contact Exotic Fish Cabo to confirm availability and trip details.
